name: Meta Ads
label: Meta Marketing API v26.0 — campaigns, ads, insights, Lead Ads
description: Official Meta Marketing API + Graph API v26.0 at https://graph.facebook.com/v26.0. Pinned to the version the Marketing API versioning page documents as current as of 2026-08-22 (https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/overview/versioning/). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Paid ads + Lead Ads only. trigger.leadgen / trigger.listen are BPMN ingress. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Example keys match api_spec.json required/queryFrom/bodyFrom.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: campaign.create | campaign.get | campaign.list | campaign.update | adset.create | adset.get | adset.list | ad.create | ad.get | insights.get | audience.create | leadForm.list | lead.get | customConversion.create | trigger.leadgen | trigger.listen.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Graph object id for get/update/insights/lead.

schema.label: ad_account_id
schema.description: Ad account id without act_ prefix. Path act_{ad_account_id}. Also config. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: page_id
schema.description: Page id for leadForm.list. Also config.

schema.label: object_id
schema.description: Insights object id (act_…, campaign, adset, ad).

schema.label: name
schema.description: Campaign / adset / ad / audience / conversion name.

schema.label: objective
schema.description: campaign.create objective. Typical: OUTCOME_TRAFFIC | OUTCOME_AWARENESS | OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT | OUTCOME_LEADS | OUTCOME_SALES.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ACTIVE | PAUSED | DELETED | ARCHIVED for campaign/adset/ad.

schema.label: special_ad_categories
schema.description: Required on campaign.create. Use [] when none. Official special_ad_categories.

schema.label: buying_type
schema.description: campaign.create buying_type. Typical: AUCTION.

schema.label: campaign_id
schema.description: Campaign id for adset.create.

schema.label: adset_id
schema.description: Ad set id for ad.create.

schema.label: daily_budget
schema.description: Ad set daily budget in cents. Official daily_budget.

schema.label: lifetime_budget
schema.description: Ad set lifetime budget in cents.

schema.label: billing_event
schema.description: adset.create billing_event. Typical: IMPRESSIONS | LINK_CLICKS.

schema.label: optimization_goal
schema.description: adset.create optimization_goal. Typical: REACH | LINK_CLICKS | LANDING_PAGE_VIEWS | CONVERSATIONS.

schema.label: targeting
schema.description: Official targeting {geo_locations, age_min, age_max, …} for adset.create.

schema.label: start_time
schema.description: ISO-8601 ad set start.

schema.label: promoted_object
schema.description: Lead ads promoted object (Page / form).

schema.label: creative
schema.description: Ad creative {creative_id} or spec for ad.create.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Comma-separated fields for get/list/insights/lead.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size; cap 100.

schema.label: after
schema.description: Graph cursor.

schema.label: level
schema.description: insights level. EXACT: account | campaign | adset | ad.

schema.label: subtype
schema.description: audience.create e.g. CUSTOM. Do not upload raw emails.

schema.label: description
schema.description: audience.create internal description.

schema.label: customer_file_source
schema.description: As Custom Audience docs. Hashed identifiers only in later ops.

schema.label: event_source_id
schema.description: Pixel or page id for customConversion.create.

schema.label: rule
schema.description: customConversion.create rule JSON string.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. Size-capped. Never log secrets or raw PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: campaign.create | campaign.get | campaign.list | campaign.update | adset.create | adset.get | adset.list | ad.create | ad.get | insights.get | audience.create | leadForm.list | lead.get | customConversion.create | trigger.leadgen | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: User, System User, or Page token (StudioQuack secret). OAuth access token minted outside StudioQuack. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Ad account id
configurationParameters.description: Numeric ad account id WITHOUT the act_ prefix (path /act_{ad_account_id}/…). Used as path param when INPUT omits it.

configurationParameters.label: Page id
configurationParameters.description: Page that owns Instant Forms / leadgen. Path param for leadForm.list when INPUT omits page_id.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
